IP Destination Group Resource Delete Destination IP Group
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/ipDestinationGroups/:ipGroupId

Deletes the IP destination group for the specified ID.

Note: Only user-defined IP groups can be deleted.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ipGroupId
int32
REQUIRED
Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
